chunk.content: Pacific yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares), one species within Fishora's genus-level tuna label, is torpedo-shaped, metallic dark blue above, yellow-to-silver below, with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins and finlets.
chunk.source_quote: Yellowfin tuna are torpedo-shaped. They are metallic dark blue on the back and upper sides and change from yellow to silver on the belly. True to their name, their dorsal and anal fins and finlets are bright yellow.
